name: hsbc-campaign-workspace
description: Root workspace scripts to orchestrate frontend (Vite) and backend (FastAPI) services.

scripts.frontend:open: npm --prefix src/frontend ci && npm --prefix src/frontend run dev
scripts.backend:query: python3 -m venv src/backend/.venv && . src/backend/.venv/bin/activate && pip install -r src/backend/requirements.txt && uvicorn src.backend.queryService:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.backend:parse: python3 -m venv src/backend/.venv && . src/backend/.venv/bin/activate && pip install -r src/backend/requirements.txt && python3 src/backend/main.py
